verdict.rationale: The features page documents a built-in assistant, Zia, that users can "Ask … in plain English." It also says AI in Zoho Books handles tasks like sending bulk collection reminders and categorizing bank statements. The MCP material covers external agents such as Claude driving Books, not an in-product assistant, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: in-depth docs on which tasks Zia can actually perform end-to-end versus only answering questions, evidence of multi-step delegation inside the app, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond one marketing page.
